summary: Implemented the Tabs widget in src/textual/widgets/_tabs.py. It renders labels above the existing UnderlineBar, with the active tab highlighted. Clicks activate the nearest tab, using each tab's label plus padding as its hit region. Keys: left/right wrap, digits 1-9 select a tab, and letters cycle through tabs starting with that letter. Changing the active tab posts TabActivated(index, label). Exported Tabs and TabActivated from widgets/__init__.py and added a CHANGELOG entry. Nothing was run, per instructions. Not done: no tests were written and no sandbox demo was added. Nothing was committed.
